Send money overseas

Make international and cross-border payments in NBCL Online Banking or at any branch. Outgoing transfers cost K70, with a daily FX transfer limit of K25,000.

Receive from overseas

Give the sender your account number, BSB and NBCL's SWIFT code: NBCLPGPG. Incoming transfers cost K15.

Spend abroad

Use your Classic Visa Debit Card wherever Visa is accepted, in store and at ATMs.

Travel notification

Tell us before you travel.

Let us know where and when you're going so your card keeps working overseas and we can spot unusual activity.

Money markets

Invest in PNG government securities.

NBCL supports corporate, institutional and high-net-worth investors with Bank of Papua New Guinea securities. We act solely as an authorised intermediary and dealer for these auctions.

Talk to our Treasury team
Central Bank Bills Short-term liquidity instruments issued by the Bank of PNG through regular auctions. Treasury Bills Government-backed fixed-income securities, with interest returns across a range of maturities.
